in_house.note: Denominated in INR already, so the FX correction does not move it. This is why the in-house floor is unaffected by the FX and audio findings.

do_not_mix.rule: Three different numbers must never be conflated.
do_not_mix.generated_cost: USD or INR per second the provider bills, whether or not the output is kept.
do_not_mix.accepted_cost: Cost per second ONIQ actually ships, which includes spend on rejected attempts. Always >= generated cost.
do_not_mix.customer_price: GST-inclusive INR the user pays. Set from accepted cost plus margin, never from generated cost.
